decoder_policy: OpenCV QRCodeDetector, then QRCodeDetectorAruco only if the first returns nothing; no preprocessing; outcome exact/mismatch/failure; only exact is classified (D6, D21)

distortion_implementation.rotation: about centre, white fill, canvas expanded to fit (no cropping)
distortion_implementation.perspective: keystone: top-left corner -> (frac*w, 0), top-right -> (w - frac*w, 0), bottom corners fixed
distortion_implementation.low_resolution: INTER_AREA down, INTER_NEAREST up; controlled digital degradation, not a camera model
distortion_implementation.jpeg: encode + decode in memory with OpenCV at the given quality
